name: getmessage-options
description: getMessage options on seeded POP3 messages. Paging of a long body (maxBodyChars, bodyOffset, a limit above the maximum), the three body formats of an HTML message (hidden elements are removed and counted in bodyNote) and of a multipart/alternative one, rawSource as text and as base64 (pages on 4-character groups), inline images of a multipart/related part with includeInlineImages (included, skipped for an unsupported type, an RFC 2231 name read in the raw message) and without it, saveAttachments (files in the temporary directory, two attachments of one name, an image of a multipart/related part) with the saved files attached again to a draft and compared byte for byte, a message that only has an attachment, a message with no Subject (rawSource too) and an attachment with no name, empty plain and HTML bodies, an encrypted message (content withheld, also when it has no From or To; its reply and forward are refused), odd attachments (undecodable base64, empty, a detached attachment that is only a link, an attached message) with the forward refused for the link. Errors: unknown message, unknown folder, arguments out of range. Not reached: a raw source that is not valid UTF-8 (the seeded files are UTF-8), the recovery of an attachment from the raw message after a wrong size, failures of the temporary directory, an image over the base64 limit. Nothing is sent.
